title: Planning Over Rough Ground: Paying for Sand and Slope in Energy, Paying for Risk, and When the Shortest Way Is Not the Cheapest

questions.question: What does the work per metre over a cell depend on, besides the surface?
options: The slope along the heading the vehicle takes

questions.question: A metre up a slope of 14 degrees cost, against across it:
The shortest path across the sand band cost, and the cheapest:
options: 90 J and 66 J, at 16.0 m and 31.2 m

questions.question: Crossing the patch of risk, the worst cell cost was:
options: 200 with no weight and 0 with one

questions.question: Why does the planner price a step and not a cell?
options: The cost depends on the heading, on a slope

questions.question: What does a goal in a ring of blocked cells give?
options: found = false and an empty path, after 6476 expansions
